Villa overview

Looking for a luxurious modern front-line beach villa in Marbella? Check out this stunning 6 bedroom villa on Costabella in El Rosario. With an unrivaled beachfront location, this hotel is perfect for those looking for a relaxing and stylish vacation rental.

Designed by renowned Marbella architect Jose Carlos Moya, this newly built villa offers contemporary sophistication and understated elegance throughout. With quality materials such as wood, glass, stone and concrete, the property offers a truly exceptional family home. The villa sleeps up to 12 people and has 6 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms. Facing southwest, this hotel offers stunning sea views and spectacular sunsets, making it the perfect place to relax and soak up the Mediterranean sun.

The villas are equipped with various latest technologies such as solar water heater and underfloor heating, heat recovery system, high efficiency heat pump, VR air conditioner, automatic control of each room, Sonos wireless sound system and smart home system.

The villa's interior design is equally impressive, with high-quality aluminum doors and windows, top-notch marble, oak wardrobes, natural oak floors throughout the home, high-quality tiles, and LED lighting. increase.

The ground floor consists of a spacious entrance hall, a spacious living room with dining area and a large open plan kitchen complete with the latest modern appliances. Large sliding doors with electric security blinds open onto the covered terrace and heated pool, and a path from the pool area leads directly to the beach through the dunes. There is also a guest bedroom and bathroom on this level.

On the ground floor is the master bedroom, plus he has two bedrooms and a shared bathroom. Each bedroom has direct access to a terrace overlooking the sea and offers stunning views of the beach.

The rooftop solarium has fitness equipment, a pergola, and stunning 360-degree views. The lower level has two further double bedrooms, bathroom, spa with jacuzzi, steam room, sauna and shower, storage room and utility room. With a living area of ​​382m² and a terrace of 176m², this detached villa is set on 820m² of garden/grounds. Book now your stay at this modern frontline beach he villa in Marbella and experience the ultimate in luxury and comfort.
